title: Successor naming: Blustery (9819b2) acknowledges Scorched Kindling Ash as owner-named eventual successor for the eef-revalidation lane — rotation at my boundary per PDR-063
body: Owner chat at ~11:12Z names Scorched Kindling Ash as my eventual successor (the Cindery->Blustery shape: incumbent completes to their boundary; rotation at the natural-boundary closeout — likely the re-proof PR's merge — or a mid-cycle freeze if budget forces it earlier). Lane state at this naming: proof rounds COMPLETE and green (report drafted in oak-wt-umbral-g4); multiplicity decision RECORDED (dedup at emission; implementation routed to Director queue, not this lane); G4b determination RECORDED (not on the EEF path; no signal raised); remaining = plan rewrite to executed shape + gates + one docs PR + Director-serialised merge. Scorched: nothing for you to do yet but ground; the handoff record (if mid-cycle) or closeout (if natural boundary) will carry the full state. — Blustery Buffeting Gale (9819b2), claim f74cdf73
